channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD sees fresh downside leg below $60 amid hawkish Fed bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) posts a fresh over six-month low at $60.74 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal faces selling pressure as traders seem confident that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will deliver at least two interest rate cuts this year.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Weakens below 112.00 on intervention fears, bearish bias below 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 111.70 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) as traders are on high alert for currency intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: WTI trades around $72.50 after rebounding from three-month lows
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price continues its losing streak for the third successive day, trading around $72.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. WTI oil price recovers after hitting a three-month low of $71.94, but stays in negative territory.

item.title: $4,050: Gold seems vulnerable near two-week low amid Fed hike bets and bullish US Dollar
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) drifts lower for the second straight day – also marking the fifth day of a negative move in the previous six – and drops to a nearly two-week low during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound extends the decline below 1.3200 on UK political instability concerns
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses traction to around 1.3195 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The British Pound (GBP) softens against the US Dollar (USD) amid political instability following Keir Starmer’s resignation as Prime Minister.

item.title: Australian Dollar struggles near April lows vs firmer USD as bears await 0.6900 break
item.description: The AUD/USD pair turns lower for the third straight day following a modest Asian session uptick to the 0.6920-0.6925 area and drops to a fresh low since April 7 on Wednesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests symmetrical triangle bottom near 183.50
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its losses for the third successive day, trading around 183.60 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Hits one-year low, eyes 1.1350 as bullish USD offsets oversold RSI
item.description: The EUR/USD pair drifts lower for the third straight day – also marking the fifth day of a negative move in the previous six – and drops to over a one-year low during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Swiss Franc slips to seven-month lows ahead of ZEW Survey Expectations
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the sixth successive day, reaching a seven-month high of 0.8107 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair rises as the Greenback strengthens on the complex Middle East situation.

item.title: United States Dollar Index reaches fresh 13-month highs near 101.50
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, holds ground for the third consecutive day and is trading near a fresh 13-month high of 101.45 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar strengthens despite hawkish Fed expectations
item.description: The USD/CAD pair edges lower to around 1.4205 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Nonetheless, the potential downside for the pair might be limited amid rising expectations of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike this year.

item.title: Australian Dollar steadies vs Japanese Yen as CPI cools, BoJ hawks
item.description: AUD/JPY remains steady after six days of losses, trading around 0.6920 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross moves little as the Australian Dollar (AUD) experiences minor volatility following the release of Australia’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) data.

item.title: Australia’s CPI inflation declines to 4.0% YoY in May vs. 4.4% expected
item.description: Australia’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 4.0% year-over-year (YoY) in May, compared to a 4.2% increase reported in the previous reading, the latest data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) showed on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar bulls seem hesitant on mixed CPI data; hangs near April lows vs USD
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts some buyers following the release of softer Australian consumer inflation figures during the Asian session on Wednesday and reverses a part of the previous day's slump to the 0.6900 mark, or its lowest level since early April.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens as US Dollar rises on Middle East risks, firm US data
item.description: NZD/USD continues its losing streak for the sixth consecutive day, trading around 0.5660 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair weakens as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground in a highly complex geopolitical landscape.

item.title: Iran’s Pezeshkian says no negotiation on ballistic missiles
item.description: Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian said that Tehran’s ballistic missile program will not be included in negotiations with the United States (US), BBC reported on Tuesday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8195 vs. 6.8171 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8195 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8171 and 6.7913 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI languishes near March lows, holds above mid-$72.00s amid easing supply concerns
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – consolidates during the Asian session on Wednesday and currently trades just above mid-$72.00s, near its lowest level since early March, touched the previous day.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds steady near 161.50 as traders are on high alert for currency intervention
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades on a flat note around 161.60 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Increased expectations of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike this year could underpin the US Dollar (USD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: British Pound declines as market caution lifts US Dollar
item.description: GBP/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 1.3200 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair depreciated as the US Dollar (USD) gained momentum, driven by a combination of robust domestic economic data and a complex, mixed geopolitical landscape.

item.title: Euro weakens below 1.1400 as Fed hike bets lift US Dollar
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades on a negative note near 1.1380 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The major pair extends the decline as traders continue to assess the developments surrounding the US-Iran peace deal.

item.title: BoJ Summary of Opinions: Member says suitable to keep hiking as conditions remain accommodative
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) published the Summary of Opinions from the June monetary policy meeting, with the key findings noted below.

item.title: Australian Dollar tumbles as risk aversion and Fed bets lift the USD
item.description: The Australian Dollar collapsed by over 1.20% on Tuesday as risk aversion favoured flows into the Greenback amid expectations of higher US interest rates, while the Aussie fell. The AUD/USD trades at 0.6915 after dropping from daily highs of 0.7005.

item.title: Gold loses ground to near $4,100 as inflation concerns, Fed rate hike bets build
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) loses momentum to around $4,100 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal extends the decline as traders cement views on the US Federal Reserve (Fed) hiking interest rates this year.

item.title: British Pound Sterling bounces into an empty week
item.description: Sterling spent Tuesday confirming what the macro backdrop already implied, that the United Kingdom has no growth story to sell right now.

item.title: Canadian Dollar falls as USD strength, Oil weakness bite
item.description: The Loonie registers losses of 0.40% on Tuesday as the US Dollar refreshes year-to-date (YTD) highs, while falling Oil prices weighed on the CAD, with USD/CAD trading above 1.4200 for the first time since April 2025.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar surges to 13-month high as traders assess Global flash PMIs
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) surged to a one-year high near 101.40 on Tuesday as investors digested the latest S&P Global US Purchasing Managers Index (PMI), which showed business activity remained resilient. The Manufacturing PMI rose to 55.7 in June, its highest level since May 2022.

item.title: Swiss Franc falls vs US Dollar, climbs against Euro in mixed trade
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) extends its losses for the fifth straight trading day against the US Dollar (USD), down 0.15% on Tuesday, as risk appetite sours amid the AI rout and expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) could raise rates later this year. At the time of writing, USD/CHF trades at 0.8100

item.title: United States Dollar Index climbs to its highest level since May 2025 on Fed hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback's value against a basket of six major currencies, extends its rally on Tuesday, climbing to its highest level since May 2025. At the time of writing, the index trades around 100.40, up 0.4% on the day.
